items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire (Must be through the American Heart Association)
Conducts initial evaluations on assigned inpatients within 24 hours of receipt of order, ensuring they are completed within 48 hours
Performs initial evaluations for newly referred patients to determine the primary and secondary problems involved. Collects baseline data and determines the appropriateness of the prescribed care

Develops a patient treatment plan based on the information obtained from the initial evaluation, including modalities/procedures to be used, treatment objectives, frequency of patient visits, and time frame for short-term goals
Re-assesses the patient's progress and revises the treatment plan on a bi-weekly basis or sooner

Completes documentation in the patient's chart which includes the subjective and objective responses and any anticipated changes in the treatment plan. Reviews patient care plan daily and adjusts it appropriately
Instructs the patient and/or family for home program education and rationale for the various aspects of the treatment program and completes appropriate documentation
Graduate of a school of physical therapy approved by the American Physical Therapy Association
Physical Therapist: CA, upon hire and
Ability to perform duties and make decisions in stressful situations and prioritize patient needs and other duties
